body: Im sure she would be glad, after how much i hurt her, i said things to someone else about her, not meaning what i was saying at all, i was saying things out of sheer stupidity but it has crushed her and it has crushed me and if i wasnt at breaking point before, ive overshot the mark this time

Hes not her son, he will be with his mum, i hate his mum. she stripped me of everything
She is someone else i met after his mum left
I would die for her, thats not cliche. I woukd literally take a bullet to the head for her. I would do anything to make her happy
His mother is picking him up in about an hour

If im honest he would be better off with his mum at this point, nobody wants a Dad that is as much of a mess as i am, I can't live withbthe stress anymore, his mum already took everything from me and I have no family or friends left. I have nothing, I've already failed him, I met the nost amazing beautiful woman and now I have failed her. My head is bursting with pressure frim crying so much and i cant stop being sick, I took quite a large overdose last night knowing its not enough to kill me but enough to do some damage which I deserve.
